headword: {半影|はんえい}{月食|げっしょく}

definitions.explanation: A lunar eclipse in which the Moon passes only through Earth's outer shadow (penumbra), so it dims slightly rather than darkening sharply.

examples.japanese: {半影|はんえい}{月食|げっしょく}は{分|わ}かりにくい。
examples.english: A penumbral lunar eclipse is hard to notice.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}の{半影|はんえい}{月食|げっしょく}では{月|つき}がわずかに{暗|くら}くなった。
examples.english: In today's penumbral lunar eclipse the Moon dimmed only slightly.

examples.japanese: {半影|はんえい}{月食|げっしょく}は{部分|ぶぶん}{月食|げっしょく}よりも{変化|へんか}が{小|ちい}さいので{見逃|みのが}しやすい。
examples.english: A penumbral lunar eclipse changes less than a partial one, so it is easy to miss.

notes:
Composed of {半影|はんえい} (penumbra; partial shadow) + {月食|げっしょく} (lunar eclipse).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {半影|はんえい}{月食|げっしょく}が{起|お}こる: a penumbral lunar eclipse occurs
- {半影|はんえい}{月食|げっしょく}を{観測|かんそく}する: to observe a penumbral lunar eclipse

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {部分|ぶぶん}{月食|げっしょく}: partial eclipse — part of the Moon enters the dark umbra
- {皆既|かいき}{月食|げっしょく}: total eclipse — the whole Moon is in shadow
